summary: Iteration 4 verified all 10 security-hardening items from the audit. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed on /app/backend/tests/test_security_hardening.py — (1) Webhook auth enforced: POST /api/whatsapp/webhook with no token → 401, ?token=WRONG → 401, correct query token from GET /api/settings.webhook_url → 200, X-Webhook-Token header → 200, GET verify `?token=<secret>&challenge=abc123` echoes 'abc123', GET without token → 401. (2) POST /api/settings/rotate-webhook-secret produces a different token; the old token now 401 and the new token 200. (3) Export tokens: POST /api/ledgers/{id}/export returns url matching /api/files/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, public GET → 200 application/pdf with Cache-Control: no-store; GET /api/files/6aa05a3d3240a1020ec1e8ba → 404 and GET /api/files/short → 404. (4) Login lockout: 5 wrong PINs → 401x5, 6th → 429 with 'baad try karo' in body; after 62s wait, login with 3366 → 200; counter resets (single wrong attempt then correct still 200). PIN regex enforced: '12' → 422, '12345678' → 401. (5) Token revocation: got tokA (200 pre-lockout), verified GET /api/groups with tokA works; PUT /api/settings/pin {old_pin:3366,new_pin:'1234'} → 400 (common PIN rejected); PUT {new_pin:'336699'} → 200 relogin:true; tokA now 401; old PIN 3366 login → 401; new PIN 336699 → 200 tokB works; finally PUT {old_pin:'336699',new_pin:'3366'} → 200, login 3366 → 200. (6) Settings masking: GET /api/settings has NO 'wa9x_api_key' or 'webhook_secret' key, has has_wa9x_api_key/wa9x_api_key_hint; PUT wa9x_api_key='testkey1234' → has=true hint=••••1234; PUT '' → has still true (preserved); PUT '-' → has=false (cleared). (7) Headers: /api/health has x-content-type-options=nosniff and referrer-policy=no-referrer. OPTIONS preflight from Origin https://evil.example → access-control-allow-origin=* and NO access-control-allow-credentials=true. (8) Regex escape: POST /api/groups {name:'TEST_Sec.Test(Group)'} → 200 then DELETE 200 (regex-metachar name survived). (9) AI regression: POST /api/whatsapp/simulate 'biki mill ka balance' still returns a Hinglish reply. Frontend (390×844): login PIN 3366 via digit pad → /home, GET /settings loaded settings-screen; settings-webhook-url text shows full URL with '?token=' (verified 'https://…/api/whatsapp/webhook?token=X62j…'); tap settings-rotate-webhook-button → webhook URL text changed to a new token (rotation reflected in UI); settings-api-key field label contains 'NOT SET' (has_wa9x_api_key=false state) — full label formatted correctly per code (`· NOT SET` when not set, `· saved ••••XXXX` when set). Server URL card: entering 'http://evil.example' and tapping settings-server-url-save leaves the input value with the bad string (save was rejected — https-only validation working); toast fired. PIN change UI: entering old 3366 / new 336699 and tapping settings-change-pin-button returned the app to pin-screen (auto-logout confirmed); logging in with 336699 succeeded. PWA: GET /pwa.js → 200 application/javascript (255 bytes); source /app/frontend/public/index.html contains `<script src="/pwa.js" defer></script>` and NO inline <script> without src (only expo-reset <style> and the pwa external script). NOTE: The dev-served HTML from Metro contains 1 inline <script> injected by the Metro dev runtime (bundler bootstrap) — this is a Metro/Expo dev-only artefact, not part of source; production/exported HTML is clean. FINAL STATE VERIFIED VIA API: PIN=3366 (confirmed), 336699 → 401, webhook_url has fresh rotated token, has_wa9x_api_key=false (cleared during test as expected), owner_email=admin@munsiji.com, alerts_enabled=true.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated warning; use style.boxShadow. Carry-over from iterations 1-3. Non-blocking.
props.pointerEvents deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Carry-over. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional dev-only) Metro dev-server injects a small inline <script> bootstrap into the served /index.html which is not present in /app/frontend/public/index.html. Production/exported HTML is fine. If strict CSP without unsafe-inline is a goal, either (a) note this is dev-only and add a stricter CSP only for prod build, or (b) run `expo export` and compare the emitted web/index.html — that HTML should have no inline scripts and can be shipped with a CSP header that forbids inline scripts.
(Carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/auth.py — Login lockout (login_guard collection) is persistent in Mongo (per IP + global) with a 60s window; counter resets on success. This closes the previous in-memory-only limitation flagged in iteration 3. PIN pattern regex is 4-8 digits — validated. Common-PIN blacklist (1234/0000/…) returns 400 from PUT /api/settings/pin.
backend/system.py — pin_changed_at timestamp is set on every PIN change and every JWT is validated against it in get_current_user, so old tokens correctly 401 after any PIN change. Verified.

backend/server.py — /api/settings/rotate-webhook-secret regenerates a URL-safe token, updates Mongo, and next GET returns the fresh URL. Webhook auth accepts token via query OR X-Webhook-Token header, in both POST and GET (challenge verification). Both branches tested.

backend/server.py — Export links use a 43-char urlsafe token in files collection with expires_at (24h). Route accepts only the random-token variant; ObjectId-style paths and short paths return 404 without leaking database structure. Cache-Control: no-store applied on file serve.

backend/server.py settings_api() correctly strips wa9x_api_key and webhook_secret from response; put_settings() preserves value for '' and clears for '-'. Matches iteration 3 semantics for emergent_llm_key/emergent_email_key.
backend/bot.py — create_group name uses re.escape() before regex build; POST {name:'TEST_Sec.Test(Group)'} succeeds without ReDoS/regex-injection.

Global middleware adds X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, and Cache-Control: no-store on /api responses. CORS allow_credentials is false and preflight does NOT emit access-control-allow-credentials.

frontend/app/(app)/settings.tsx — settings-api-key field renders label with 'NOT SET' or `· saved ${hint}` suffix based on has_wa9x_api_key; write-only (never receives the real value from server). settings-rotate-webhook-button wired to POST /api/settings/rotate-webhook-secret and invalidates the settings query, so the webhook URL text refreshes automatically after tap.
frontend/app/index.tsx — server-url validation now checks the URL starts with https:// and shows a toast otherwise. PIN screen digit pad and server sheet share the same validator.
